def mode(a): return Counter(a).most_common(1)[0][0]
def infer_transform(grid, debug=False):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
 row_modes=[mode(row) for row in grid]
 col_modes=[mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
 rf,cf=Counter(row_modes),Counter(col_modes)
 shared=set(rf)&set(cf)
 line=min(shared,key=lambda c: (rf[c]/h + cf[c]/w, rf[c]+cf[c]))

program='''from collections import Counter

def _mode(values):
    return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [_mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [_mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    row_counts, col_counts = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    shared = set(row_counts) & set(col_counts)
    line_color = min(shared, key=lambda color: (
        row_counts[color] / h + col_counts[color] / w,
        row_counts[color] + col_counts[color],
    ))

    separator_rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    separator_cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]
    marked_rows = [r for r in separator_rows
                   if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in separator_cols)]
    marked_cols = [c for c in separator_cols
                   if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in separator_rows)]
    first_row, last_row = min(marked_rows), max(marked_rows)
    first_col, last_col = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    separator_rows = [r for r in separator_rows if first_row <= r <= last_row]
    separator_cols = [c for c in separator_cols if first_col <= c <= last_col]

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if r not in separator_rows and c not in separator_cols]
    background = _mode(interior)

    result = []
    for top, bottom in zip(separator_rows, separator_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for left, right in zip(separator_cols, separator_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[top][left], grid[top][right],
                       grid[bottom][left], grid[bottom][right])
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(value == corners[0] for value in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        result.append(row)
    return result
'''
